_note: Files Relic copies INTO the game folder after an install/import and re-checks before every launch. 'common' applies to every version; 'versions' only to that id. 'sha256' is verified: if the file in the game folder already has this hash it is not rewritten. 'backup': keeps the original as <name>.relic-orig the first time.
_note_bin: The injector sources carry a .bin suffix, not .exe/.dll: 'dotnet publish' drops exactly those two from the output (a plain build copies them), so the ship build mirrors payload/ explicitly in publish.ps1 — and the suffix keeps antivirus away from the copy in {app}. The real names are restored at the destination ('dst').
_note_inject: 'inject': true marks an entry as an extra DLL for launcher.exe: when the 'In-game enhancements' setting is on (RelicSettings.Enhancements, default on) the entry is copied like any other and, at launch, handed to launcher.exe AFTER mhynot2.dll (launcher.exe <GameDir> <mhynot2.dll> <dst...>) on Windows 10 and 11 alike — the real mhyprot2 driver must never load under the mod. With the setting off the entry is neither copied nor verified nor deleted, and the launch is the plain per-OS one. Always 'required': false — a missing inject file costs the menu, never the launch. Such entries live under 'versions' (per game build) as '<ver>/ee/CLibrary.dll.bin' -> 'ayy/anime/ee/CLibrary.dll' (never a folder named 'bin'); their default hotkey F1 is what Relic's strings tell the player; publish.ps1 prints the size per inject entry and warns above 80 MB. Entries are added by entertainment_experience/tools/build_ee.ps1 once the DLLs exist.

common.reason: mhynot2 injector — on Windows 11 the game only starts through it (mhyprot2 driver).
